# CI/CD & release

All pipelines run on GitHub Actions. Several workflows still point at the upstream repo `earthians/biograph` (release PRs, release notes, docs check API).

## On every PR
- **CI / Server Tests** (`ci.yml`): Python 3.14 + Node 24 + MariaDB 11.8. Runs `compileall`, checks for merge-conflict markers, bootstraps a bench (`.github/helper/install.sh`), then runs `bench run-parallel-tests --app healthcare`. It skips PRs that only touch css/js/md/html/csv, as well as `version-*-beta` bases. It also runs nightly at 00:00 UTC, and scheduled runs upload coverage to Codecov.
- **Linters** (`linters.yml`, `linters.v2.yml`; the latter also runs on push): pre-commit (ruff, ruff-format, prettier, eslint, pip-audit, detect-secrets, file checks) and Semgrep with the Frappe rules plus `r/python.lang.correctness`.
- **Semantic Commits**: commitlint over the PR's commits.
- **Documentation Required**: `feat` PRs need a docs link.
- **Labeler**: adds `needs-tests`.
- **CodeQL** (python, javascript) on `develop` PRs and pushes, plus weekly.

## Merge
Mergify auto-merges after one approval and green checks (merge commit by default; the `squash` label squashes). It also handles backport labels.

## Release
- `initiate_release.yml` (weekly, Tuesday 09:30 UTC) opens `version-NN-hotfix → version-NN` release PRs for 14, 15 and 16.
- `on_release.yml`: pushes to `version-14/15/16` run **semantic-release** (`.releaserc`, angular preset; breaking changes don't trigger a release). It bumps `__version__` in `healthcare/__init__.py`, commits `chore(release): Bumped to Version x.y.z`, and creates the GitHub release.
- `release_notes.yml` regenerates the notes and strips chore/ci/test/docs/style entries.
- `generate-pot-file.yml` (weekly) refreshes `locale/main.pot`. Crowdin opens translation PRs.
- Dependabot is configured in `.github/dependabot.yml`.

Deployment is done by whoever runs the bench (`bench update` / Frappe Cloud). The repo contains no deploy job.
